description: We are a team passionate about mathematics, physics, and technology. We enjoy exploring complex ideas, solving challenging problems, and discovering connections between different scientific fields.
summary: Astro-sistant is a health-tracking interface for exploring astronauts in space. It displays astronaut profiles and spacecraft details, along with charts for bone and muscle density, heart rate, and sleep. Health data is simulated based on microgravity trends, not real measurements.
details:
- Search astronauts by name or spacecraft and browse their profiles.

- View simulated bone and muscle density trends over a 180-day mission.

- Explore a 24-hour heart-rate chart and sleep-duration data for the last seven nights.

- Review concise status cards for bone density, muscle mass, heart rate, and sleep.

- Read the project presentation in [`AstroSistant_Sunum.pdf`](./AstroSistant_Sunum.pdf).
